status: FROZEN BEFORE RETRIEVAL, ROUTING, GROUNDING, STRUCTURAL GENERATION AND ADJUDICATION
task_full_prompt: Implement the first production unresolved-frontier and bounded acquisition-request capability for Localization. The capability should let an incomplete Localization assessment represent exactly what repository observation or evidence is still missing for an applicable obligation, preserve task, obligation, repository/snapshot, candidate-hypothesis and native evidence provenance, distinguish unresolved evidence from accepted witness support and from justified non-applicability, and express bounded follow-up acquisition requests without selecting Retrieval algorithms or claiming that requested evidence will satisfy the obligation. Integrate coherently with the existing task interpretation, anchor grounding, candidate witness association, witness generation, accepted witness alternatives, LocalizationAssessment and readiness contracts; preserve deterministic identity and replay validation; expose enough structure for future autonomous orchestration to request additional repository evidence without moving orchestration policy into Localization; add rigorous tests and authoritative architecture/development documentation; preserve package/API conventions where applicable; and pass protected development validation. Do not implement automatic hypothesis resolution, candidate elimination, numeric confidence, learned ranking, autonomous acquisition execution, Context Planning admission, or agent retry policy.
purpose: Acquire and generate repository information needed to implement the frozen unresolved-frontier and bounded acquisition-request capability while prospectively comparing global lexical, obligation lexical, role-routed and bounded structural witness-generation surfaces.

anchors.text: Unresolved repository-observation/evidence frontier and bounded follow-up acquisition requests
Incomplete LocalizationAssessment and obligation applicability dispositions
WitnessGenerationView and existing bounded generation contract
AnchorGroundingView and exact native evidence provenance

obligations.predicate: Establish the current contracts needed to represent exactly the missing repository observation or evidence for an applicable obligation, with an explicit unresolved frontier.

satisfaction.name: frontier-semantics-contract
satisfaction.statement: Current unresolved assessment and obligation-predicate contracts constrain the new frontier without asserting evidence absence or satisfaction.

obligations.predicate: Establish incomplete assessment/disposition and justified non-applicability semantics so a frontier cannot convert missing evidence into non-applicability.

satisfaction.name: assessment-applicability-contract
satisfaction.statement: Assessment applicability, open/abstained/deferred states and non-applicability evidence remain distinguishable.

obligations.predicate: Establish how unresolved frontier information can preserve candidate-hypothesis and generation provenance without resolving or eliminating candidate hypotheses.

satisfaction.name: candidate-integration-contract
satisfaction.statement: Unresolved hypothesis identities, complementary members, competing alternatives and generation lineage remain explicit.

obligations.predicate: Establish accepted-witness alternatives and positive support semantics that must remain distinct from unresolved evidence and acquisition requests.

satisfaction.name: witness-boundary-contract
satisfaction.statement: Frontiers and requests cannot become SupportedWitness values or satisfy WitnessSet alternatives by themselves.

obligations.predicate: Establish architectural constraints for bounded follow-up acquisition requests describing missing evidence without selecting Retrieval algorithms, executing acquisition or promising satisfaction.

satisfaction.name: acquisition-contract-contract
satisfaction.statement: Requests preserve purpose, obligation, missing observation and explicit bounds while remaining algorithm-independent non-authorizing representations.

obligations.predicate: Establish grounding and native evidence contracts needed to retain exact source provenance through unresolved frontier and acquisition representation.

satisfaction.name: grounding-provenance-contract
satisfaction.statement: Retained grounding/native referents and evidence provenance remain exact and independently replayable.

obligations.predicate: Establish task/obligation and repository/snapshot qualification and deterministic identity/replay constraints for all frontier/request links.

satisfaction.name: frame-identity-contract
satisfaction.statement: Foreign, stale, duplicate and mismatched task/obligation/snapshot/evidence links are rejected without current-filesystem substitution.

obligations.predicate: Establish readiness and deferred-discovery behavior that new unresolved frontiers and requests must preserve.

satisfaction.name: readiness-integration-contract
satisfaction.statement: An unresolved mandatory obligation remains blocking; accepted conditional discovery is separate from resolved witness coverage and full readiness.

obligations.predicate: Establish ownership boundaries between Localization acquisition-request representation and future autonomous acquisition execution, retries and Context Planning.

satisfaction.name: orchestration-boundary-contract
satisfaction.statement: Execution, authorization, retry policy and Context admission remain outside Localization; requests carry no execution authority.

obligations.predicate: Establish package ownership, public facade and allowed dependency conventions for the reusable frontier/acquisition capability where applicable.
obligations.applicability_condition: Applicable when the new reusable capability requires public package/API exposure or changes existing package/dependency conventions.

satisfaction.name: package-api-contract
satisfaction.statement: New public capability follows existing package/facade conventions and dependency direction with no experiment dependency in production.

obligations.predicate: Establish repository test contracts needed to validate frontier/request semantics, boundaries, provenance, frame rejection and readiness integration rigorously.

satisfaction.name: tests-contract
satisfaction.statement: Tests exercise positive/negative state and frame behavior, deterministic replay and nonclaims using existing supported test conventions.

obligations.predicate: Establish authoritative architecture and development documentation requiring updates for the new frontier/request capability.

satisfaction.name: documentation-contract
satisfaction.statement: Current semantic/package/architecture claims and documentation authority are updated coherently without rewriting historical evidence.

obligations.predicate: Establish protected development validation and static-quality requirements for the implementation.

satisfaction.name: validation-contract
satisfaction.statement: Canonical protected tests, coverage gate, Ruff, formatting, mypy and diff checks pass; confirmation is excluded.
